## Checklist

- [ ] Lint, typecheck, and tests pass locally (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`)
- [ ] No secrets, signing credentials, or personal swing data committed
- [ ] ADR added/updated in `docs/adr/` if this changes an architectural decision
- [ ] If native camera/ML/billing dependencies changed: tested on a physical device, not just simulator/emulator (PRD section 12.6)
- [ ] If a model changed: version bumped, checksum updated, evaluation report attached (PRD section 8.3)
